news.story.Definition

This class describes parameters to retrieve data for news story.

Available as lseg.data.content.news.story.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(story_id: str, extended_params: ExtendedParams = None)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
story_id str Yes The ID of news story.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Other parameters can be provided if necessary

Methods

get_data

Returns a news story response from the Data Platform.

get_data(session: Session | None = None)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

NewsStoryResponse

get_data_async

Returns a news story response asynchronously from the Data Platform.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None User-defined callback function to process the received response.
closure str | None No None Optional closure that will be passed to the headers and returned.

Returns

NewsStoryResponse

Example

from lseg.data.content import news
definition = news.story.Definition("urn:newsml:reuters.com:20201026:nPt6BSyBh")
